answer: Artifact-filing bonds stop mass fake identities. A newcomer locks 70 credits and files one artifact in the cedar registry, onyx-stamped to its key. A falcon auditor replays each artifact; copied or rented ones share one work-hash, so the falcon flags the ring and all bonds burn. First filing costs 40; the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep the bond.
